title: GeneratePress Premium + GenerateBlocks Developer for Custom WordPress Landing Page
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer to build a custom landing page using GeneratePress Premium and GenerateBlocks.

We already have the desktop and mobile design direction, page copy, branding, and overall layout. The work is primarily implementation.

This is not an Elementor project. We are intentionally moving away from Elementor and want this page built cleanly using GeneratePress Premium + GenerateBlocks, with reusable styles and components that can support future landing pages.

Scope of Work

The contractor will:
-Build the landing page in WordPress using GeneratePress Premium + GenerateBlocks
-Recreate the provided desktop and mobile designs as closely as practical
-Build the page in a clean, lightweight, responsive way
-Use native GenerateBlocks controls wherever possible
-Use custom CSS only where needed for polish
-Create reusable styles/classes/patterns for:
  -Hero sections
  -Content cards
  -CTA sections
  -Process steps
  -FAQ styling
  -Buttons
  -Spacing and typography
-Ensure all page content remains easily editable in WordPress
-Preserve the existing SmartDispute.ai header/footer style
-Optimize for performance and avoid unnecessary plugins or libraries
-Test the page across common desktop and mobile breakpoints

Important Requirements

You should have direct experience with:
-GeneratePress Premium
-GenerateBlocks
-Gutenberg/block-based WordPress development
-Responsive landing page development
-Custom CSS
-Performance-conscious WordPress builds

Please do not apply if your primary approach is Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, or another page builder.

Development Approach

The page should be built on a staging environment.
We do not want:
-Elementor
-Large custom HTML sections replacing native blocks
-Unnecessary plugins
-Code that is difficult to maintain
-Copy or layout changes made without approval

We do want:
-Clean GenerateBlocks structure
-Reusable components
-Sensible class naming
-Easy future editing
-Strong mobile implementation, not simply stacked desktop sections
-Deliverables
-Completed desktop version on staging
-Completed mobile-responsive version
-Cross-browser/device testing
-Performance cleanup
-Reusable styles/components for future landing pages
-Clean handoff with any custom CSS documented

Proposed Milestones

Milestone 1:
-Desktop and mobile landing page completed on staging and approved visually.

Milestone 2:
-Responsive QA, browser testing, performance cleanup, reusable components, and final handoff.

To Apply

Please include:
-2–3 examples of sites or landing pages you have built specifically with GeneratePress and/or GenerateBlocks
-A short description of your role on those projects
-Your estimated timeline

Also answer this question:
How would you structure this page using GeneratePress Premium and GenerateBlocks, and which parts would you make reusable for future landing pages?

We are looking for someone who understands GeneratePress architecture, not simply someone who can reproduce a screenshot.
coverLetter:
Hi! To structure this cleanly in GeneratePress Premium and GenerateBlocks, I’ll use GP's Elements (Block Hooks) for the header/footer integration and GP's Global Styles for typography/spacing. For the page content, I’ll build with GenerateBlocks Containers and Grid blocks, utilizing GB’s Global Styles feature to create reusable classes for your Hero, Cards, CTA, and FAQ sections. This keeps the CSS footprint tiny and ensures non-tech editors can easily reuse these components.

I recently built clean, block-based custom WordPress sites like https://www.thelifeyoucansave.org/, focusing strictly on performance and Gutenberg. For GP/GB specifically, I recently developed a lightweight marketing hub and a SaaS landing page (role: sole developer, Figma-to-code). I can complete this on a staging site within 4-5 days.

Let's jump on a quick chat to review your Figma designs and get started. When are you available?

title: WordPress + Bricks Builder Developer - E-Commerce Site for Downloadable Custom Scorecard Templates
description:
Job Title: WordPress + Bricks Builder Developer - E-Commerce Site for Downloadable Custom Golf Scorecard Templates 

Job Description: I need an experienced WordPress developer to build a live e-commerce website using my existing HostStinger, WordPress and Bricks Builder accounts. The site design is underway in Figma and I have a complete site map documenting the page structure and flows (Attached) I also have a brand guidelines that displays the typography and colors. 

What the site does: Customers browse categories of custom-designed golf scorecard templates (memorial tournaments, golf trips, corporate events, birthdays, and more), view a watermarked preview, and purchased a template. After checkout, the customer receives an editable InDesign or Illustrator file (Via download and/or email) that they customize and print themselves. Their is no in-browser design tool in this phase - that will be added later as a separate project, so please do not scope it into your quote. 

Scope of Work: 
- Build the site in WordPress + Bricks Builder matching the Figma design, site map while utilizing the brand guidelines. 
- Set up a WooCommerce product catalog (or propose an alternative) organized by category/sub-category. 
- Watermarked template preview pages with description, artist info, and reviews
- Cart, checkout, and order confirmation flow that delivered the purchased file (download link or emailed) 
- Customer accounts (individual Customers and Golf Course Individual Users): Registration/Login, Order History, saved designs 
- Golf Course section: course search/registration (Course manger profiles) individual course scorecard page, and contact details. 
- Blog and Newsletter sign up, present in the footer site wide
- Global header/footer matching he site mock up 
- fully responsive (desktop, tablet, mobile) and cross browser tested. 
- Basic SEO, performance, and security best practices (SSL, spam protection, backups)
- Build the "Originals" product category on the backend but keep it un published/hidden from customers for now, structure so it can be switched on later with minimal work. 
- Brief documentation on managing products, templates, and blog posts after launch. 

Requirements: 
- Proven experience with WordPRess + Bricks Builder (Please share examples) 
- Experience with WooCommerce or a comparable e-commerce setup, including delivering digital/downloadable products
- Comfortable working from a sigma file and a site map without needing additional design work
- clear communicator, able to work within my existing hosting, WordPress, and Brick Accounts. 

What to include in your account: 
2-3 relevant past projects (Ideally Wordpress + bricks, and any involving digital/downloadable product delivery. 
- Your proposed approach to the product catalog, watermarking, and file delivery flow. 
- Your estimated hours (required, even for fixed price quote) 
- Any Questions or gaps you see in the attached specifications. 

Budget and Timeline: 
- Budget = $1,000 - $5,000
- Timeline: 6-8 weeks 
- Attachments: See below.
coverLetter:
Hi! I can build your golf scorecard template e-commerce site using Bricks Builder and WooCommerce on your Hostinger account, exactly matching your Figma designs.

For the digital delivery and watermarking, I recommend WooCommerce's native downloadable products feature paired with a secure, non-public file directory to prevent unauthorized sharing. For the watermarked previews, we can utilize a lightweight image optimization tool to automatically generate protected web-ready previews of your InDesign templates.

I've built complex custom WordPress sites like https://www.seeintl.org/ and have extensive experience configuring WooCommerce for seamless digital checkouts. I estimate this build will take approximately 65–80 hours over 6 weeks.

Do you have the golf course database structure ready, or should we design the course search/registration flow from scratch? Let's chat!

create a new section page from the template
add text per language
swap out photos/audio

Links: Pretty Links

Experience with Polylang (multilingual setup)
